item.title: US debt tops $40 trillion, Americans left with the bill
item.description: The US national debt has officially surpassed $40 trillion for the first time in history, and it’s growing fast.

item.title: Pakistan’s Imran Khan back to prison after evaluation at hospital
item.description: Pakistan’s former Prime Minister Imran Khan was sent back to prison after being transferred for a medical evaluation.

item.title: US Vice President JD Vance holds midterm election rally in Ohio hometown
item.description: The vice president's speech hinged heavily on economic themes, as voter confidence slips for Republican policies.

item.title: TikTok settles with US Justice Department for $400m over child privacy laws
item.description: TikTok and the US government settled to resolve allegations that the app violated children's online privacy laws.

item.title: Mexico Governor Ruben Rocha returns to office despite US criminal charges
item.description: The governor, who leads the state of Sinaloa, has been accused by the Trump administration of partnering with a cartel.

item.title: One killed, three wounded in sword attack at Swedish high school
item.description: One person has been killed and three others wounded in an attack by a sword-wielding man at a Swedish high school.

item.title: Arsenal rout Coventry 3-0 to begin Premier League title defence in style
item.description: Kai Havertz struck early, Bukayo Saka doubled the lead, before Martin Odegaard netted after the break.

item.title: Global Sumud Flotilla joins Albania’s anti-resort protest
item.description: Three boats from the Global Sumud Flotilla arrived in Albania’s Vlore on Friday to support the “Flamingo Revolution"

item.title: Tunisian protesters call for President Kais Saied to step down
item.description: Hundreds of Tunisians took to the streets of the capital Tunis on Thursday, calling for president Kais Saied to leave.

item.title: Can a humanitarian disaster be averted in Somalia?
item.description: The UN warns of another hunger crisis, with starvation threatening millions.

item.title: Pope Leo urges the world to ‘help begin reconstruction’ of Gaza
item.description: Pope Leo XIV is appealing to authorities around the world to support the people of Gaza who are ‘still suffering'.

item.title: Bolivia’s President Rodrigo Paz fires economy minister amid unrest
item.description: Jose Gabriel Espinoza removed from post days after he was censured by the legislature amid tumult over economic reform.

item.title: Western allies slam Israel for ending World Central Kitchen strike probe
item.description: UK, Australia and Canada call Israel’s decision not to investigate deadly 2024 strike on a Gaza aid convoy 'shameful'.

item.title: US Supreme Court allows Trump’s ballroom project to continue for now
item.description: The Trump administration has argued the $400m White House ballroom is needed for national security purposes.

item.title: Trump waives ‘out-of-quota’ beef tariffs for 90 days to lower prices
item.description: The president did not mention with whom he made the deal or where the imported ground beef is coming from.

item.title: US court slashes Alex Jones fines for Sandy Hook school shooting case
item.description: Court cuts Infowars founder's penalty for false claims that school shooting was a 'hoax' from $50m to $1.5m.

item.title: Libya rivals test a new path towards unity, 15 years after Gadaffi downfall
item.description: Fifteen years since Tripoli fell, Libyan parties are finally working towards unity.

item.title: US, Canada negotiators race to ink a deal as Trump’s tariff deadline looms
item.description: Experts say even a last-minute breakthrough will not result in the US lifting all its tariffs on Canadian goods.

item.title: Palestinian victims of Israeli settler attacks face battle for justice
item.description: Palestinians with missing relatives are marking International Day of Remembrance and Tribute to Victims of Terrorism.

item.title: Turkiye accuses Israel’s Netanyahu of ‘genocide’, seeks Interpol warrant
item.description: Netanyahu and Erdogan trade insults as Ankara seeks warrant for Israel's attacks on Global Sumud Flotilla activists.

item.title: Secret tunnel becomes museum for Syria chemical attack and siege of Ghouta
item.description: A Ghouta tunnel used during Assad’s siege is now a museum, 13 years after government forces’ deadly sarin gas attack.

item.title: Espanyol vs Real Madrid: La Liga – prediction, lineups, teams
item.description: Real Madrid kickoff their campaign at Espanyol in Barcelona as Jose Mourinho's targets winning La Liga return.

item.title: Drone strike on Ukraine shopping centre kills 14, over 100 injured
item.description: A Russian drone strike hit a major shopping centre in Kryvyi Rih, Ukraine, killing 14 people and injuring over 100

item.title: Former Pakistan PM Imran Khan taken back to prison after hospital check-up
item.description: Relatives of former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan say he’s being tortured in prison.

item.title: Russian drone attack on busy shopping centre kills 15 in Ukraine
item.description: Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelenskyy slams 'cynical and despicable' attack on his hometown Kryvyi Rih that injured over 130.
